meta.title: V4.1 Pro engineering controls
meta.description: Improves long-task execution with real exit codes, test evidence, failure fingerprints, and persistent ledgers. Includes optional model escalation, independent review, on-demand language-optimization and fiction-writing skills, a long-novel workspace, divergent/focused/thorough (max only)/automatic thinking modes, and local reliability checks; it does not change model weights or claim an unmeasured benchmark advantage.
